date_note: Victoria Police's release, republished by Mirage News on 27 November, says the man was charged overnight; the page gives no earlier day.
exec: Victoria Police has charged people over false construction certificates and over a data breach involving a former union member.
geo_basis: Cheltenham, Victoria, the address where the release says a warrant was executed
plain: Victoria Police charged another man over false construction certificates and sharing intimate images. Earlier, three men were charged over false certificates and three over a data breach involving a former CFMEU member.
summary: Mirage News, republishing a Victoria Police release, says Taskforce Hawk detectives charged a Cheltenham man overnight with seven counts of making a false document and distributing an intimate image, after a search warrant the day before. The release says three men were earlier charged over false certificates and three over a report of a data breach involving a former CFMEU member and the sharing of personal information and photographs.
title: Victoria Police Taskforce Hawk charges man over false certificates; earlier arrests include a CFMEU-member data breach

validation.note: Single source: Mirage News republishing the Victoria Police release; the police's own page was not read.

review.note: charge, Cheltenham, seven charges, earlier three+three vs Mirage/Victoria Police release
